title: Orbit Jump
author: Frederik77
selftext:
So, I've implemented Orbit Jump on three different GenAI-platforms so far (Upit, Rosebud and now Astrocade), and I think this latest version is perhaps prettier than the other ones. I've tried to improve the gameplay experience a bit, making it longer, more colorful, with more lives, moving it a step away from the hypercasual outset. Would love to hear your feedback, as it's a game concept I keep returning to and try to impove :)
